x.text:
Before we solve AI alignment, we have a pretty serious human alignment problem. 

It is jarring to see the bad-faith reaction to Dario's piece from so many sides. I don't agree with every point of his essay but do believe it is a thoughtful piece everyone should read. It builds on some of the ideas @demishassabis  raised in July.

It is clear we need to focus on aligning amongst us humans on a few questions:

What is the opportunity, risks, second-order effects?

How do we measure all of this?

How do companies, governments and countries coordinate?

AI will benefit humanity if we can get our act together and move together.
x.bio: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
x.textZh:
在解决 AI 对齐问题之前，我们面临着一个相当严峻的人类对齐问题。

从各方对达里奥（Dario）文章的恶意反应中，人们感到震惊。我并不完全同意他文章中的每一个观点，但我相信这是一篇深思熟虑的文章，每个人都应该阅读。这篇文章建立在 @demishassabis 今年 7 月提出的部分观点基础之上。

显然，我们需要专注于在人类之间就以下几个问题达成共识：

机会、风险以及二级效应是什么？

我们如何衡量这一切？

企业、政府和国家如何协调合作？

如果我们能够团结一致、协同行动，AI 将造福全人类。

x.text:
If you showed me Claude Code today in 2018, I would have thought it was AGI.

We have already absorbed a dramatic amount of change in the profession of software engineering and society as a whole. But still, we’re starting to see cracks.

Things are accelerating faster than I can honestly stay on top of. Most people I know in AI are tired but powering through. I fear we will need more than that.

We need time to harden our systems, and for society to deliberate in how this technology is used and deployed.

I have a fairly low p(doom), I am confident that we can get through this! Humanity is incredibly reslient and adaptable, but this comes from our ability to make hard decisions- like this one, together.
x.bio: Claude Code @anthropicai. prev YC W20, @spc, @medialab
x.textZh:
如果2018年有人向我展示 Claude Code，我会以为那就是通用人工智能（AGI）。

软件工程行业乃至整个社会已经经历了巨大的变革。然而，裂痕已然显现。

发展速度之快，已超出我个人能实时跟进的极限。我认识的绝大多数 AI 从业者都感到疲惫，但仍坚持前行。我担心，仅靠这种状态是不够的。

我们需要时间来加固系统，需要社会就这项技术的使用与部署进行审慎讨论。

我对“末日”概率的评估较低，我有信心我们能渡过难关！人类具有极强的韧性与适应能力，但这源于我们共同做出艰难决策的能力——就像眼下这一抉择一样。

Good post. Don’t agree with all of it, but it represents many of the actual practical realities for the general path forward in frontier AI whether we like it or not.

At the level of capability we’re seeing from models there will inevitably be some form of coordinated self-regulation of the industry; that’s generally a good thing. The big question will be if everyone can agree to what that is. However, the way things are headed politically there’s a chance that the labs won’t even get a say in it.

And then the bigger question yet is do all the countries participate or not. Any “slow down” hinges on broad participation, which from a game theory standpoint isn’t likely until the risks are more severe and obvious.

Expect this to be pretty messy for a while.
x.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
x.textZh:
写得好。虽然我不完全认同文中的所有观点，但它确实反映了前沿人工智能（AI）未来发展的许多实际现实，无论我们是否喜欢。

从目前模型展现出的能力水平来看，行业不可避免地会采取某种形式的协调自我监管；这总体上是件好事。但关键问题在于，各方能否就监管的具体内容达成一致。然而，从当前的政治走向来看，实验室甚至可能没有发言权。

更大的问题在于，各国是否会参与。任何“放缓”都依赖于广泛的参与，而从博弈论的角度来看，只有当风险更加严重且明显时，这种广泛参与才可能发生。

预计这种情况在一段时间内会相当混乱。
